name: Icon of Blood procs on melee and ranged abilities (#13174, #12236)
contract: #13174, #12236: Icon of Blood (proc dummies 202027, 312524, 316524, 320524) never procced. Every dummy
carries Spell.dbc ProcFlags 0 and the world had no spell_proc row, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it.
Tooltip: "Melee and ranged abilities", tiers "(30sec. internal cooldown)". Flags 272 (melee and ranged
abilities) as the merged Shadowcraft and Beaststalker 3-piece rows. spell_proc_chance reads each loaded
entry's chance, which equals the record's ProcChance, and spell_proc_cooldown_ms reads each loaded cooldown.
aura_proc_rate replays the aura's native proc decision, including the roll, 40000 times on one synthetic
event per check. It procs on a landed melee ability (Heroic Strike 78), a landed ranged ability (Arcane Shot
3044), at the record's chance; it never procs on a landed melee auto attack, a landed ranged auto attack, a
landed direct magic spell (Frostbolt 116). Before the repair the chance and cooldown lookups fail with
'Spell has no proc entry' and every rate reads 0, so the discriminating checks fail instead of flaking.
